logs.heading: Log Data
logs.description: Drop a .skylog or .bin file. One skylog can contain several boards - the tool figures out each flight's board on its own. Everything is computed locally.

help.summary: How to enable the full skylog (-extended_log flag)
help.intro: Without the -extended_log flag, Skyline only logs the raw {tlm:...} record, and the numbers can only be recovered from .bin. To get decoded telemetry:
steps: Right-click the Skyline LRS shortcut → Properties.
In the Target field, after the closing quote, add a space and -extended_log.
Save and launch Skyline through this shortcut - new logs will have full telemetry.

filter.label: Filter by board - optional (partial match, applies live)
filter.hint: Empty - shows all flights. Type part of a board number and the table filters live.

drop.title: Drop a log: .skylog / .bin
drop.subtitle: or click to choose a file
